_comment: Candidates for identifying a source typeface, and equivalents for common licensed fonts. fetch_fonts.py resolves any Google Fonts family by name, so this list is a starting point, not a limit.
_pdf_aliases: Font names lifted out of a PDF are often subset-tagged (ABCDEF+Helvetica-Bold) and frequently name a licensed face. Strip the tag, then map to a metric-compatible free equivalent, or keep the original name when the font is installed on the target machines.
_windows_fonts: Faces already installed on every Windows machine, so they need no embedding: Arial, Arial Narrow, Calibri, Cambria, Candara, Consolas, Constantia, Corbel, Courier New, Franklin Gothic, Georgia, Impact, Segoe UI, Tahoma, Times New Roman, Trebuchet MS, Verdana.
